_comment: ESPN MMA scoreboard bouts in each live and finished state, for test_round_break_stays_live.py. Recorded cases are whole, unedited competitions from the source URL; the two derived cases are marked as such. Findings: the live displayClock counts DOWN (time left in the round). Between rounds ESPN sends STATUS_END_OF_ROUND, state "in", shortDetail "End R<n>", clock 0.0 and displayClock "-" (the Round End play clock) -- not "0:00". A stoppage shows the same status at the stoppage clock (e.g. "0:51") until the result posts. STATUS_FINAL (state "post") ends a fight, after which the clock is the ELAPSED finish time (5:00 for a decision).
